question: How do I update my payment method?
answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Payment methods. Only workspace owners and billing admins can add or replace cards. Changes take effect on the next invoice.

question: Where can I download invoices?
answer: Open Settings > Billing > Invoices. PDF invoices for the last 24 months are available. For older invoices, email billing@novadesk.example.

question: How do refunds work?
answer: Unused prepaid months on annual plans may be refunded within 14 days of renewal if usage is under 10% of seats. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. Chargebacks without contacting support may suspend the workspace.

question: What is the seat overage policy?
answer: If you exceed purchased seats, NovaDesk bills prorated overage at the plan's per-seat rate on the next invoice. Growth and Enterprise can enable auto-add seats in Billing settings.
